@about: The Apparel add-on's words (pattern making). Pattern makers' terms: piece, grade rule, size range, base size, notch, grain line, seam allowance, marker.
piece.name: Pattern piece
cmd.piece.help: Make a pattern piece from a closed polyline, or from lines and arcs that join into one outline
cmd.notch.help: Put notches on a piece's edges (slit, V or T)
cmd.drill.help: Put drill holes on a piece
cmd.foldline.help: Cut a piece on the fold: mark the fold line on one of its edges
cmd.intline.help: Draw an internal line on a piece (darts, pockets, placement lines)
cmd.seam.help: Set a piece's seam allowance: per edge, all round, or none; and how the cut lines meet at each corner
ask.seam: Click an edge to set its seam allowance
done.seam.net: No seam allowance: a net pattern.
cmd.grade.help: Sizes and grading: the size range and base size, a grade rule for any point, copy, paste, flip, proportional, and the nest view
ask.grade: Click a point to grade (sizes {sizes}, base {base})
ask.sizes: Size range (names in order, e.g. XS S M L XL)
ask.base: Base size: the size the pieces are drawn in ({list})
ask.grade.step: Move of {key} per size from the base (x,y), or T to type it size by size
ask.grade.copy: Click the point to copy the rule from
ask.grade.paste: Click the points to paste the rule on (Enter to finish)
ask.grade.flip: Click the point whose rule to flip
ask.grade.remove: Click the point whose rule to remove
ask.grade.to: Last point (its rule is kept); the points between follow in proportion
grade.nosizes: This piece has no size range yet: choose Sizes first.
err.sizes: Type at least one size name.
err.base: The base size must be one of {list}.
err.move: Type the move as x,y (for example 5,-2.5).
err.norule: That point has no grade rule.
err.proportional: Pick two different points of the sew line.

done.sizes.one: Size range {list}, base {base}: set on {n} piece.
done.sizes.other: Size range {list}, base {base}: set on {n} pieces of this style.

done.nest.on: Nest view on: every size is drawn on the base.
grading.pick: Select one pattern piece to see its size range and grade rules.
grading.nest: Nest view (every size on the base)
cmd.seamlength.help: Measure a piece's sew line between two places, both ways round, in every size
cmd.walk.help: Walk one seam against another: the two edges' lengths, the difference and how their notches line up
cmd.piecetable.help: List every piece in every size: sew and cut line perimeter and area; CSV
ask.len.a: First place on the sew line
ask.len.b: Second place on the sew line
done.len: Along the sew line: {fwd} one way, {back} the other (all round {total}).
ask.walk.a: Click the first piece on the edge to walk
ask.walk.b: Click the second piece on the edge to walk against it
done.walk: Size {size}: first edge {a}, second edge {b}, difference {diff}.
done.walk.notch: Notch {n} at {a}: the other notch lands {off} away.
done.walk.unpaired: Notches with no partner: {a} on the first edge, {b} on the second.
table.none: There are no pattern pieces in this drawing.
cmd.patternprint.help: Print the pattern at full size: on a plotter (a page as big as the pieces) or tiled on A4 or Letter with overlap and match marks, in the sizes you choose
print.title: pattern
print.toobig: A page is bigger than 200 in (5.08 m), the most a PDF page can be: print it tiled, or fewer pieces at a time.

done.print.full.other: {name}: {n} pages at full size, one per size.

done.print.tiled: {name}: {n} pages ({tiles} tiles and a cover page per size). Print at 100 % (actual size).
print.full.label: Size {size} at full size (1:1)
print.cover.title: Pattern, size {size}: tiled pages
print.cover.how: Print at 100 % (actual size) on {paper}. Trim each page on its outer line, lay the pages in their rows and columns, overlap them by {overlap} so the diamonds meet, and tape.
print.cover.check: This square must measure {side} each way. If it does not, print again at actual size (no fit to page).
cmd.aamaout.help: Save the pattern as DXF-AAMA or ASTM D6673 for other pattern programs and cutters: a DXF, and a RUL file for the grading
cmd.aamain.help: Open a DXF-AAMA or ASTM pattern (pick the DXF and, when it has one, its RUL file together)
aama.in.nodxf: Choose the pattern's DXF file (and its RUL file, if it has one).
aama.in.empty: {name} has no pattern pieces CadCraft can read (no closed cut line on layer 1 or 84).
aama.note.range: {name} has another size range than the first piece: its grading is written by size name.
aama.note.points: {name}: its cut or sew line has a different number of points in some sizes; those lines are written without rules. Save with Nested grading to keep every size.
aama.note.big: {name} is too big to carry its CadCraft data in the file; it reads back from the drawn lines.
aama.note.ungraded: {name}: its {n} sizes are more grading than one piece can hold, so only the sample size was read.
aama.note.toobig: {name} has too many points to keep as one piece, even with its curves thinned: left out.
aama.note.nooutline: {name}: no closed cut line, left out.
aama.note.nestpoints: {name}: its sizes have different numbers of points, so only the sample size was read.
aama.note.norul: {name} has grade rule numbers but no RUL file was given: only the sample size was read.
export.astm: ASTM D6673 pattern, every size drawn (Apparel)
cmd.graderule.help: The grade rule library: save a point's rule by name, apply saved rules to points, and import or export the library (JSON or RUL)
ask.lib.point: Click the point whose rule to save
ask.lib.name: Name for the rule (for example shoulder +0.3 cm)
ask.lib.points: Click the points to give "{name}" (Enter to finish)
lib.empty: The grade rule library is empty. Save a rule from a graded point first.
err.lib.unknown: No rule called "{name}" in the library.
err.lib.file: {name} is not a grade rule library (JSON) or a RUL file.
done.lib.save: Saved the rule "{name}" in the library.
done.lib.rul: Exported {n} rules as a RUL file ({left} with another size range left out: a RUL file has one range).
grading.lib.name: Name to save as
cmd.marker.help: Lay out a marker: the fabric's width, whether it can be turned (one-way fabric with a nap or a print cannot), and the grain tolerance
cmd.markeradd.help: Put pieces in a marker's sizes and quantities beside it, ready to drag onto the fabric
cmd.markerout.help: Save a marker as DXF (one block per piece on the fabric) or as a PDF at full size
cmd.markernest.help: Let CadCraft lay a marker's pieces on the fabric: grain kept, turned only where the fabric allows, the marker kept short
marker.name: Marker
placed.name: Marker piece
marker.label: {name}: fabric {w} wide, marker {len} long, efficiency {eff} %, {placed} of {total} pieces on it
marker.nap.any: Fabric may be turned; grain within {tol}°
marker.nap.oneway: One-way fabric (nap or print): no turning, no mirroring; grain within {tol}°
marker.refused.overlap: {name} would overlap another piece: put back.
marker.refused.edge: {name} would go off the fabric: put back.
marker.refused.grain: {name}'s grain line would be off the fabric's length by more than the tolerance: put back.
marker.refused.turned: {name} cannot be turned round on one-way fabric: put back.
marker.refused.mirrored: {name} cannot be mirrored on one-way fabric: put back.
marker.empty: There are no pieces on {name} yet.
ask.marker.name: Marker name
ask.marker.qty: Sizes and quantities ({list}; for example S:1 M:2)
err.marker.qty: Type sizes from {list} with how many, for example M:2 L:1.
done.marker: Made the marker {name}. Use MARKERADD to bring pieces to it.

done.marker.add.one: {n} piece waits above {name}: drag it onto the fabric with MOVE.
done.marker.add.other: {n} pieces wait above {name}: drag them onto the fabric with MOVE (ROTATE to turn one).

opt.nest.rest: The rest (keep what is on the fabric)
marker.nest.none: {name} has no pieces yet: bring them with MARKERADD first.
marker.nest.all_on: Every piece of {name} is on the fabric already. Choose All to lay them out again.
marker.nest.big: {name} is wider than the fabric: left where it was.

done.marker.nest.one: Placed {n} piece on {name}: {len} long, efficiency {eff} %. Move pieces by hand if you like; Undo takes it all back.
done.marker.nest.other: Placed {n} pieces on {name}: {len} long, efficiency {eff} %. Move pieces by hand if you like; Undo takes it all back.

ask.outline: Select a closed polyline, or the lines and arcs that make the outline (this is the sew line)
ask.name: Piece name
ask.notch: Click on an edge for a {kind} notch
ask.drill: Click where the drill hole goes
ask.fold: Click the edge the piece is cut on the fold at
err.notpiece: That is not a pattern piece.
err.newer: This piece was made by a newer Apparel add-on. Update the add-on to change it.
err.width: The seam allowance must be zero or more.
err.outline.type: A piece needs a closed polyline, a circle or an ellipse, or lines, arcs and open polylines that join into one outline.
err.outline.open: The outline is not closed: its ends do not meet.
err.outline.gap: These do not join end to end into one outline.
err.outline.few: An outline needs at least three points.
err.outline.many: The outline has too many points (2,000 at most).
done.fold: The piece is cut on the fold.
prop.name: Piece name
